blocks.text: 今天，与 @ggerganov 一起，我们非常激动地宣布 llama.cpp v1 发布，这是最常用的本地运行 AI 模型库的首个完全稳定的主要版本，意味着可以在你的手机、笔记本电脑和工作站上运行。

inlines.text: 今天，与 @ggerganov 一起，我们非常激动地宣布 llama.cpp v1 发布，这是最常用的本地运行 AI 模型库的首个完全稳定的主要版本，意味着可以在你的手机、笔记本电脑和工作站上运行。

blocks.text: 这意味着你可以免费拥有自己的智能，不把数据发送给任何人，并且无论你身处世界何处都能 100% 掌控。这体现了我们支持所有硬件、平台和模型类型的承诺，并让 AI 走向分布式，而不是集中在硅谷的少数机构手中。

blocks.text: Today, with @ggerganov we’re super excited to announce the release of llama.cpp v1, the first major fully stable version of the most used library to run AI models locally, meaning on your phone, your laptop, and your workstation.

inlines.text: Today, with @ggerganov we’re super excited to announce the release of llama.cpp v1, the first major fully stable version of the most used library to run AI models locally, meaning on your phone, your laptop, and your workstation.

blocks.text: It means you can own your intelligence for free, not send your data to anyone and be 100% in control, wherever you are in the world. It shows our commitment to support every hardware, platform and model type out there and makes AI distributed rather than concentrated in a few Silicon Valley orgs.
